mapper.sql: id, industry_name, industry_code, description, status, remark, sort_order, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.industry_name, t.industry_code, t.description, t.status, t.remark, t.sort_order, t.created_by, t.updated_by, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM industry t
ORDER BY t.sort_order ASC, t.id DESC

SELECT t.id, t.industry_name, t.industry_code, t.description, t.status, t.remark, t.sort_order, t.created_by, t.updated_by, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM industry t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0

SELECT t.id, t.industry_name, t.industry_code, t.description, t.status, t.remark, t.sort_order, t.created_by, t.updated_by, t.created_at, t.updated_at, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM prompt_template_industry pti INNER JOIN prompt_template pt ON pt.id = pti.template_id AND pt.deleted = 0 WHERE pti.industry_id = t.id ) AS prompt_template_count FROM industry t
ORDER BY t.sort_order ASC, t.id DESC
